title: contract-v1 hook event envelope
description: The single JSON object a harness adapter puts on the core's stdin. The envelope is fixed across every event_type; only `payload` varies. Source of truth for contract-v1 (portability ADR sec.2.1 / sec.6). Changing this file is an ADR-amendment event, not a casual edit.

contract_version.description: Semver of the contract the adapter speaks. Core rejects a MAJOR it does not implement.

event_id.description: Correlates the response to the event; used by H-OBS and audit.

event_type.description: Selects the core module, and the event's CATEGORY. GATE/enforcement types (git-boundary; carry ticket+changeset) vs DATA-BOUNDARY types (carry a fixture + boundary, never a ticket). `boundary` is honored ONLY on data-boundary types. Unknown -> block on enforcement, no-op on obs.

harness.description: Free-form audit label ONLY. The core must not branch on it.

requested_mode.description: The posture the adapter can surface. Core policy may HARDEN it (warn->block) but never SOFTEN a fail-closed module.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body. For a PII-scrub-guarded event this carries `boundary` (import-into-repo | egress-to-judge) and a structured `fixture`. Per-payload sub-schemas are owned by the substrate and eval ADRs.
